  "first_3_seconds": "A Judge violently slams a gavel and shouts 'Silence!' while pointing aggressively at a trembling maid in a courtroom.",
  "ending": "The Judge bellowing 'You will speak when addressed!' as Lady Juliana is silenced mid-protest, with the Lord smugly confirming a 'ritual' just before the cut.",
  "problems": [
    "Standalone score suffers because the specific stakes (what 'treatments' or 'herbs' are being accused of) are vague without prior context; a stranger might not grasp why herbs equal a crime.",
    "The emotional escalation is slightly repetitive (tears, shouting, more tears) which can feel melodramatic to the point of fatigue if the visual variety isn't high enough.",
    "The transition from the maid's testimony to the Lord's interruption happens quickly, potentially leaving a new viewer unsure who the Lord is relative to the other characters."

  "pitch": "The immediate violence of the gavel slam and the high-stakes accusation of witchcraft/rituals create an irresistible hook that demands the viewer see the verdict."
